ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure is a schematic diagram of Millikan's experiment. Two horizontally placed metal plates, after being charged, are disconnected from the power supply; the distance between the plates is d, and the potential difference is U. Now a sprayer is used to spray many oil droplets into the space between the plates through the small hole in the middle of the upper plate. If one oil droplet of mass m can just be suspended between the plates, and the gravitational acceleration is g, then which of the following statements is correct
A. The magnitude of the charge carried by this oil droplet is $\frac{mgd}U$
B. Millikan measured the charge of the electron through this experiment
C. The charge carried by this oil droplet may be $-2.0\times10^{-18}C$
D. If the upper metal plate is translated downward by a distance, this oil droplet will move upward
